question.prompt: If the expansion of \((x+2)(x^2+ax+b)\) contains neither an \(x^2\) term nor an \(x\) term, find the values of \(a\) and \(b\) (answer in this order, separated by a comma).

solutions.explanation: Expanding gives \(x^3+(a+2)x^2+(b+2a)x+2b\). The coefficient of the \(x^2\) term satisfies \(a+2=0\), giving \(a=-2\). The coefficient of the \(x\) term satisfies \(b+2a=0\), giving \(b=4\).
solutions.title: Set the missing coefficients to zero
